verdict.rationale: Chargebee has a documented Export resource/API that produces downloadable zip/pdf files of exported data via async jobs, and a full REST API allows programmatic data retrieval, but exports are described as zip/pdf downloads rather than explicitly open standard formats (e.g., CSV/JSON schema-documented exports), and there's no evidence of a bulk 'export all account data' or full account portability feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of open/standard export formats (CSV/JSON), a comprehensive full-account data export/migration feature, and independent confirmation of successful bulk export/leave workflows.
